headlines.title: Ericsson Shares Slump as Earnings Hit by Weakness Outside of Core Networks Business
headlines.summary: The company’s shares fell to the bottom of the Stoxx Europe 600 index as higher operating costs and weakness in some of its business units dented earnings.

headlines.title: Verizon Results Boosted by Higher Prices, Gain in Wireless Customers
headlines.summary: The New York telecommunications giant’s quarterly earnings beat Wall Street forecasts as higher prices helped to boost revenue.

headlines.title: If You Need to Escape a Wildfire in an EV, Here Is What to Know
headlines.summary: Driving an electric car in a wildfire emergency has its own unique challenges and benefits.

headlines.title: CaixaBank's CFO Sees Case for Dealmaking Among Europe's Banks
headlines.summary: Growth through acquisitions isn’t part of CaixaBank’s latest three-year plan, it should be for other banks in Europe, Caixa’s finance chief Javier Pano said in an interview.

headlines.title: Tesla to Recall Cars in China on Safety Concerns
headlines.summary: Tesla China plans to fix 1.2 million China-made and imported vehicles with software issues.

headlines.title: Korea Zinc Shares Rally After Adopting New Investor Protection Rules
headlines.summary: Korea Zinc’s shares rose sharply a day after the world’s leading zinc smelter decided to adopt new rules that management said would bolster minority shareholders’ rights.

headlines.title: Burberry Sees Positive Signs as Turnaround Plan Continues
headlines.summary: The company upgraded its earnings outlook as sales returned to growth in the Americas, saying efforts to revamp its brand showed positive signs over the key holiday period.

headlines.title: Rolls-Royce Strikes Contract to Supply Nuclear Reactors for U.K. Submarines
headlines.summary: Rolls-Royce will manufacture nuclear reactors to power new U.K. submarines under a contract valued approximately at $11.1 billion.

headlines.title: China's WeRide Wants to Build Global Robotaxi Empire
headlines.summary: The Chinese autonomous-driving company is aiming to make more inroads overseas this year, betting that robotaxis and related services will be in high demand in coming years.
